summaryText:
Pastor Travis Hearn opened the new six-week series, Changed, with a testimony from Andy Elliott. Andy shared how, after a difficult season for his family, he moved from simply believing in God to walking with God daily through surrender to Jesus and the Holy Spirit. Pastor Travis then used the picture of a caterpillar and a butterfly to show that God does not just improve us, he transforms us into something new. The church read a shared declaration anchored in 2 Corinthians 5:17, giving God full access to change every area of life.

Part one of the series is about changing the mind. Pastor Travis taught that we cannot become who God wants us to be while thinking the way we have always thought. Drawing from Proverbs 4:23 and Romans 12:2, he explained that thoughts become beliefs, beliefs become decisions, decisions become habits, and habits become our future. He warned that drifting from God usually happens slowly, one small compromise at a time, and that what we take in shapes what we think. To put this into practice, he led the church in a six-week commitment to avoid spiritual junk food: negativity, toxic social media, content that numbs the conscience, gossip, doom scrolling, and self-defeating thoughts. In their place, he invited everyone to listen to worship music, read the declaration daily, and ask a neighbor for accountability.

Second, he taught that the mind is a battlefield. Using 2 Corinthians 10:3-5 and Ephesians 6:16, he encouraged believers to take every thought captive and reminded us that just because we think something does not make it true. He pointed to Elijah as an example of how discouragement can take hold in the mind even when circumstances have not changed.

Third, he called the church to replace the old mind with a new one, with a whatever it takes attitude. Based on Ephesians 4:22-24, he explained that Christianity is not self-improvement but replacement: putting off the old self and putting on the new. As the mind changes, our appetites change, and we begin to see ourselves through God's promises rather than past failures.

Pastor Travis closed with invitations to surrender to Jesus for the first time and to recommit to change, praying together as a church family. He celebrated 90 baptisms across both locations and encouraged everyone to invite others to join the series. The message was hopeful: God never changes, and he loves us enough to change us from the inside out.
mainPoints: Your thoughts shape your life: thoughts become beliefs, beliefs become decisions, decisions become habits, and habits become your future, so guard what you take in.
Your mind is a battlefield: the enemy works through lies one thought at a time, so we must take every thought captive and make it obedient to Christ.
You must replace the old mind with a new mind: Christianity is not self-improvement but replacement, putting off the old self and putting on the new through God's Word and the Holy Spirit.

Monday.scripture: Romans 12:2: "Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind."
Monday.focus: Invite God to renew your mind and give Him full access to change you.
Monday.action: Read the Changed declaration out loud (found in the Impact Notes app or on Instagram). Then write down one thought pattern you want God to change.
Monday.prayer: Holy Spirit, confront the way I think, how I think, and why I think. I give You full access to change my mind. In Jesus' name, amen.

Tuesday.scripture: Proverbs 4:23: "Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it."
Tuesday.focus: Guard what you take in, because your intake shapes your thoughts.
Tuesday.action: Choose one source of spiritual junk food (such as negative news, a draining social media account, or gossip) to pause this week. Replace that time with worship music or Scripture.
Tuesday.prayer: Lord, help me guard my heart and mind. Give me strength to turn away from what pulls me from You and to fill my life with what is good and true. Amen.

Wednesday.scripture: 2 Corinthians 10:5: "...we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ."
Wednesday.focus: Not every thought belongs in your mind. Just because you think it does not make it true.
Wednesday.action: Write down one lie you tend to believe about yourself, God, or your future. Beside it, write a truth from Scripture. Read the truth aloud whenever the lie returns today.
Wednesday.prayer: Jesus, I bring my thoughts to You. Where I have believed lies, replace them with Your truth. Help me take every thought captive. Amen.

Thursday.scripture: Ephesians 6:16: "In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one."
Thursday.focus: Stand firm in faith and walk through this series together with others.
Thursday.action: Text or call a trusted friend or family member. Share your six-week commitment and ask them to check in with you and encourage you.
Thursday.prayer: Father, thank You for the shield of faith. Surround me with people who point me to You, and help me stay accountable and steady. Amen.

Friday.scripture: Ephesians 4:22-24: "...to put off your old self... and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness."
Friday.focus: Change is replacement, not just self-improvement: put off the old and put on the new.
Friday.action: Name one habit, attitude, or kind of speech to put off today. Name one godly habit to put on in its place, and practice it at least once.
Friday.prayer: Lord, I want to be made new in the attitude of my mind. Show me what to put off and what to put on, and help me follow through today. Amen.

Saturday.scripture: 2 Corinthians 5:17: "Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!"
Saturday.focus: Celebrate what God is doing and prepare to invite others.
Saturday.action: Look back over your week and write down one way you have seen God at work in your thinking. Then invite one person to join you at church or online next Sunday.
Saturday.prayer: God, thank You that You never change and that You love me enough to change me. Keep working in me from the inside out, and use my life to point others to You. Amen.

title: How to Change the Way You Think and Change Your Life | CHANGED: Change My Mind
